Title:
NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):
We're going to order an airstrike onto this old fortification.
You'll have to find the radioman to confirm the coordinates.
Also watch out for that minefield nearby.
Translation:
斯文·维京（无线电）：
我们要下令对这个旧堡垒进行空袭。
你需要找到无线电员确认坐标。
还要小心附近的那片雷区。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:spy-warrior:
The airstrike should be here at any moment,
we should find a way to clear the minefield in the meantime...
Wait... my radar is going crazy!!
Watch out!! INCOMING!!
Translation:
间谍战士：
空袭随时会到，
我们得想办法清理雷区……
等等……我的雷达疯了！！
小心！！敌袭！！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Puchi:\nUgh... I'm hit, I'm not gonna make it...\nLuckily someone has to clear that minefield... see you at the Bahamas...
Translation: 普奇：\n呃……我中弹了，撑不住了……\n幸好还有人得去清掉那片雷区……巴哈马见……

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):
No, don't rush in alone!
Damn! We're losing our best people in this operation.
Proceed by yourselves...
Translation:
斯文·维京（无线电）：
不，别一个人冲进去！
该死！这次行动我们正在失去最优秀的人。
你们自己继续前进……

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nThat is the robot prototype that killed most of Chap Squad!\nDestroying it will change the tide of battle! Hold on tight, we are sending reinforcements!
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n那就是杀死查普小队大部分成员的机器人原型！\n摧毁它将改变战局！抓紧了，我们正在派遣援军！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Puchi:\nDamn it, the truck is busted. But I think I can fix it.\nGo on ahead without me while I'm at it.
Translation: 普奇：\n该死，卡车坏了。但我想我能修好。\n你们先走，不用等我。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nReinforcements have arrived, enjoy OUR own prototype!
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n援军已到，享用我们自己的原型机吧！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Aperture:\nThis unit will join on foot until critical failure.
Translation: 光圈科技：\n此单位将继续步行，直至发生严重故障。

Title: NETMESSAGE:spy-warrior:\nThanks! I probably couldn't have held this position for long by myself.\nI'll call in the airstrike now then.
Translation: 间谍战士：\n谢谢！我一个人可能撑不了多久。\n现在我来呼叫空袭。

Title: NETMESSAGE:spy-warrior:\nThat should do it. Now take me outside with you,\nI'll help you until I can regroup with Puchi and get an evac.
Translation: 间谍战士：\n应该搞定了。现在带我一起出去，\n我会帮你直到能和普奇会合并撤离。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Radio:
This is the Sven Co-op Institute receiving you loud and clear.
Looks like your suits communicators have severe interference.
Could be a malfuntioning radio tower nearby.
Try shutting down the power at your location to bring them back online. Over.
Translation:
无线电：
这里是斯文合作研究所，信号清晰。
看来你们宇航服的通讯器有严重干扰。
可能是附近有故障的无线电塔。
尝试关闭你们所在位置的电源以恢复通讯。完毕。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nOne of the walls is weak, it has already been damaged by explosives,\nuse the crates or something alike to take it down completely.
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n有一面墙很薄弱，之前已被炸药损坏，\n利用箱子或类似的东西把它完全推倒。
